description: This file implements a renderer for confirmation UI dialogs within the 'confui' namespace of the 'cuttlefish' project. It defines the 'ConfUiRendererImpl' class responsible for creating, updating, and rendering frames for confirmation dialogs, handling localization, color schemes, and user interaction detection. The 'ConfUiRenderer' class manages the rendering process and interfaces with the screen connector to display the UI.

classes.name: ConfUiRendererImpl
classes.description: Implements the core logic for creating, updating, and rendering confirmation UI frames, managing layout, localization, and color schemes.

classes.name: ConfUiRenderer
classes.description: High-level interface that manages the rendering of confirmation dialogs and interacts with the screen connector.

methods.name: GenerateRenderer
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ConfUiRendererImpl with specified display, message, locale, and options.

methods.name: UpdateLocale
methods.description: Sets the language for localization and updates translations.

methods.name: UpdateString
methods.description: Updates the text of a label with the localized string.

methods.name: UpdateTranslations
methods.description: Updates all UI text elements with current localization.

methods.name: SetDeviceContext
methods.description: Configures the rendering context with display dimensions and visual options.

methods.name: UpdatePixels
methods.description: Updates a pixel in the frame buffer with a specified color, considering alpha blending.

methods.name: UpdateColorScheme
methods.description: Adjusts color scheme based on inversion setting.

methods.name: RenderRawFrame
methods.description: Repaints the frame buffer if needed and returns the current frame.

methods.name: RepaintRawFrame
methods.description: Creates a new frame buffer with the current layout and color scheme.
